convert_quaternion_to_matrix: convert quaternions with real part first to 3x3 rotation matrices using quaternion_to_matrix
convert_matrix_to_quaternion: convert 3x3 rotation matrices to quaternions with real part first using matrix_to_quaternion
convert_euler_angles_to_matrix: convert Euler angles in radians to rotation matrices using euler_angles_to_matrix with a convention string
convert_axis_angle_to_matrix: convert axis-angle vectors to rotation matrices using axis_angle_to_matrix where magnitude is the angle
convert_6d_to_matrix: convert 6D rotation representations to rotation matrices using rotation_6d_to_matrix with Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization
